title: Bisect a regression past untestable commits
notes: skill: git bisect (or a scripted scan) with a probe that exits 0/1/125, then restoring the repository (HEAD on main at the old tip, clean tree, no bisect state); traps: untestable commits (config missing, syntax error) near but not adjacent to the boundary, an earlier transient failure across the history's midpoint so a plain root..tip bisect converges on the wrong commit, misleading fix/break commit messages, a second transient and a skip span inside the transient window (knob); pass_guess_permille: 400
